verdict.rationale: Homebrew collects anonymous aggregate usage analytics and documents `brew analytics off` to turn them off. Disabling collection indirectly keeps that usage data from being used for anything, AI training included. However, nothing in the evidence addresses AI model training or data-use policy, so this is only a glancing, indirect fit. Missing for 10: any documented policy on AI/model training use of user data, an explicit training opt-out, independent corroboration of data-handling practices.
